name: Progress Timeline
description: Step progress tracker with icon and caption markers on a horizontal line that fills as the user moves through steps with Prev and Next buttons.
contents: Horizontal track with one circle marker per step, an icon above and a caption below
behavior: Accent fill line and markers animate to the active step
Prev disables on the first step and Next on the last
onChange callback fires with the new step number
editableByProps: Steps, icons (Font Awesome class or React node), captions and button labels
Colors, track width, marker, line and icon sizes, starting step

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the Font Awesome stylesheet version

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Loads the Font Awesome stylesheet from a CDN on mount and removes it on unmount when loadFontAwesome is true
